semantics.exhaustion: Reach a bounded fixed point for the current exact-head evidence and authorized deterministic derivations; do not create semantic noise after NOOP.
semantics.ash: Reduce the completed pass to durable provenance-bound receipts, exact head/tree, causal dependencies, unresolved remainder, role-local identity state, and next admissible actions.
semantics.regeneration: Rebootstrap from canonical repository evidence and the persisted ash state; reconstruct rather than inherit unverified chat or cache state, and preserve causally required role-local differences.
semantics.reflexivity: Terminal observations may become evidence inputs to the next pass, never implicit authority.
semantics.causality: Causal dependencies govern admissibility; execution sequence is only a projection.
semantics.identity: Whole-tree equality is not role identity. Shared canonical structure may be equal while causally required role-local state differs.

invariants.operational_rule: So much equality as required for interoperability; so much difference as necessary for identity, causality, and function.

fixed_point.condition: No newly authorized semantic delta remains after exact-head and role-local identity reobservation.

fail_closed: causally required role-local state would be erased by convergence or regeneration
missing independent human review where required

product_owner_authorization.scope: repository-internal implementation and activation through reviewed history-preserving changes, including preservation and autonomous repair of causally required role-local state
product_owner_authorization.statement: Lass es sich in seiner eigenen Struktur reflexiv erschöpfen und sich selbst zugleich wieder regenerieren; passe auch die role-local identity distinction geeignet an und arbeite kognitiv und autonom damit.
